source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR2 processes LLM candidate files, source globs, filesystem writes, GitHub workflow inputs/artifacts, and specialist automation; trust-boundary regressions must be reviewed.
## SUCCESS
Identify concrete path traversal, secret leakage, command injection, race, artifact, or PR-labeling risks, or confirm no findings.
## SCOPE
Executor diff under packages/service-knowledge including Python, workflow YAML, installer/config assets.
## NON_GOALS
No edits, exploits, dependency bumps, or external repo changes.
## CONSTRAINTS
LOW permission, scan-only, cite exact evidence; SCRUTINY: high.
## VALIDATION
Threat findings map source to sink and contract impact.
## OUTPUT
Actionable security findings or clean verdict.
source.title: security-auditor: scan reconcile gate surfaces
